design_gotchas.title: Reversed SOT23R Pinout Matches AP2210N (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN), NOT AP7313-SA or LM3480
design_gotchas.detail: AP7313-33SRG-7 (SR, SOT23R, marking 'SJ') places Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=OUT, Pin 3=IN — matching AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (and common 1=GND/2=OUT/3=IN SOT-23-3 layouts), while being strictly incompatible with AP7313-33SAG-7 / AP7333-33SAG-7 (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND). Verify the 'SR' vs 'SA' ordering suffix during BOM purchasing.

design_gotchas.title: Higher Thermal Resistance (230 C/W) and Lower PD (540 mW) Than SA Package
design_gotchas.detail: Because of internal leadframe routing in SOT23R, AP7313-33SRG-7 has θJA = 230 °C/W and PD = 540 mW at 25 °C (worse than SA's 207 °C/W and 600 mW). Recompute TJ margin separately whenever switching between SA and SR variants.

design_gotchas.title: 6 V VIN Limit vs AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (13.2 V) & 55–65 uA Quiescent Current Tradeoff
design_gotchas.detail: Although AP7313-33SRG-7 shares AP2210N-3.3TRG1's 1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN SOT-23-3 pinout with lower full-load IQ (65 uA vs 4 mA) and ceramic-cap stability, its 6 V operating / 7 V abs max VIN rating makes it unsafe on >6 V rails using AP2210N (13.2 V/15 V). Its 55 uA no-load IQ also exceeds ultra-low-Iq coin-cell LDOs.

design_gotchas.title: 50 mA Short-Circuit Foldback & 10–200 mOhm Output Cap ESR
design_gotchas.detail: Current limit is 200 mA min / 300 mA typ with 50 mA short-circuit foldback below VOUT = 0.2 V. Use a 1 uF to 4.7 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitor within 10–200 mOhm ESR directly adjacent to OUT and GND.

typical_use_cases: Candidate pin-compatible ceramic-stable alternative on AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN) 5 V SOT-23-3 boards <= 150 mA
150 mA 3.3 V logic supplies for portable devices and desktop/notebook peripherals
Space-constrained 3-pin LDO rails needing 150 mV typical dropout and 1 uF ceramic cap stability
Second-source 3.3 V regulator where reversed SOT23R (1=GND, 3=IN) footprint is already locked
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP7313-33SRG-7 is the reversed-pinout SOT23R ('SR') variant of the 150 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2%) AP7313 LDO family, featuring Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=OUT, and Pin 3=IN. It shares the SA electrical ratings (2–6 V operating VIN, 7 V abs max, 150 mV typical dropout at 150 mA, 55 uA no-load / 65 uA full-load IQ, 65 dB PSRR at 100 Hz, 1 uF ceramic cap stability) but has a distinct thermal rating of θJA = 230 °C/W and PD = 540 mW at 25 °C. Its 1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN pinout aligns with AP2210N-3.3TRG1 footprints while remaining strictly incompatible with SA-suffix AP7313/AP7333 and LM3480 parts.
